notes: Exploratory probe for fromfile inclusion error behavior (lexer.w:558-560, parser.y:182-183, include_file in buffer.w): what '< "missing"' and '<< "missing"' report when the target does not exist, whether the diagnostic goes to stderr, and whether batch evaluation continues afterwards (the 3+4 line).
